title: Welcome to Sol Central: 1,000 cr once; 15 iron ore mined at Lacaille 9352 Deep Vein (2 jumps), handed in at Sol Central
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 23:13 UTC (orders ENT-068, P6: newborns do their class's work where they were born, their empire's missions first; rules F34, F35, F37). Every Solarian miner of the birth wave holds the starter mission 'Welcome to Sol Central' (mine 15 iron ore, 1,000 cr; its live file of 22:44 UTC: current 0 of 15). Sol's Main Belt reads 2 iron of 100,000 (census 11 h old); Lacaille 9352 Deep Vein read 4,791 iron (richness 30), 2 jumps by Sirius, Solarian policed space (table fields, systems). The first stop stores the starter cargo (argon gas, patches) so the hold is free; the last hands the mission in and stores the ore. Only in the rows of Solarian-born miners, never in First or a template: a Voidborn pilot holds no such mission. max_ships 3: each pilot's own mission, 45 units drawn from a field of 4,791 (under 1%), so the three runs share no buyer and do not contend for the field (F37). 2026-11-23 00:20 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 3 -> 10. 2026-11-23 00:35 UTC (fill.py, Zero): max_ships 10 -> 3. 2026-11-23 00:40 UTC (Zero): skip_if_booked also names five Voidborn starter rewards (Network Expansion, Signal Fragments, The Collective Provides, The Signal Protocol, First Steps in the Void), which 230 of 246 listed Voidborn pilots hold booked and no newborn does (data/fleet/onetime.json): the five-minute pass puts a mission that pays once into every plan's list First (00:26 and 00:36 UTC), and two Voidborn miners were sent about 10 jumps to Sol for a starter mission they do not hold. A stopgap until a route can name its empires (requests.log ENT-387).
